Hon 'b le Alok Ku m ar Ver m a,J.
 Proposed Revision has been filed assailing the
order dated 19.07.2022, passed by learned Judge, Family
Court, Udham Singh Nagar in Case No.199 of 2020,
"Gurm eet Singh vs. Karam jeet Kaur", filed under Section
13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, by which, learned
Judge has allowed the Application, filed by the respondent
no.2 under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
2 . Heard Mr. M.K. Ray, learned counsel for
revisionist, Mr. Dinesh Chauhan, learned Brief Holder for

2
State and Mr. Dinesh Gahatori, learned counsel for
respondent no.2.
3 . Learned counsel for respondent no.2 has
submitted that against the im pugned order, passed under
Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, an Appeal
(AO) should be filed.
4 . Mr. M.K. Ray, Advocate, has sought perm ission
to withdraw the present proposed Criminal Revision for
filing an Appeal (AO) against the im pugned order.
5 . With the consent of both the parties, present
proposed Revision is disposed of permitting the
revisionist-Gurmeet Singh to file an appeal against the
impugned order in accordance with law.
